title: 第十九章 直播算卦爆红，转头强拽亲吻
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
指尖再次掐诀，姜无念语气平淡：“别急，去医院西门的垃圾桶找，现在去还来得及。”

    “好好好！我这就去！谢谢大师！”中年男人像是抓住了一根救命稻草，也不管真假，匆匆挂断了连线。

    直播间瞬间开了锅，有的嘲讽姜无念自导自演，有的替她反驳，说100块已经是白菜价了，还要什么满汉全席啊。

    二十分钟后，刚才连线的那个中年男人在直播间连刷了1000元的礼物感谢她，留言说钱果然在医院西门的垃圾桶里找到了。

    姜无念通过直播后台退回了礼物，因为她从面相上看到了这男人中年丧女的命。

    人命天定，她能救一时但救不了一世，这笔钱沾了人间的悲苦，她不赚。

    这下直播间直接炸了，视频连线的申请不断跳出，挤得屏幕都卡顿。

    又随手点了一个，对面是个愁眉苦脸的中年女人，说话犹犹豫豫的：

    “大师，我儿子整天昏睡，抱着枕头喊一个陌生女人的名字，叫都叫不醒。”

    “去医院看了，说是什么幻想症，吃了几百的药了，一点没用，现在更是把自己关在房里不吃不喝，我怀疑……他是撞鬼了。”

    “把他的姓名和八字私信发给我。”姜无念没有废话，她见女人的第一眼就发现她身上缠着淡淡的鬼气，这事不简单。

    拿到八字轻轻掐算，脸上立刻浮起不屑。

    “你家有点钱，儿子长得不错，就是爱玩花心，他现在可不仅是被鬼缠身这么简单，是被厉鬼缠上了。”

    中年女人心头一惊，急忙问道：“要怎么才能解决？求大师帮忙，多少钱都行！”

    姜无念盯着她，冷笑一声：“一个月前，到底发生了什么？”

    女人脸上表情突然顿了顿，说话支支吾吾：“我……我也不太清楚，他有次朋友聚会回来就变成这样了。”

    “让他自己来说。”姜无念挥了挥手，懒得跟她绕弯子。

    愣了几秒，女人沉默着退出镜头，“儿子……儿子！吴星河你给我过来！”

    几分钟后，屏幕里出现个披着棉被，面色灰败的年轻男孩。

    他头发乱糟糟的，眼神飘忽不定，一看见镜头就炸了：“妈！你搞什么啊？这骗人的玩意儿你也信？别烦我，我要睡觉！”
content_en:
Kneading with his fingertips again, Jiang Wu Nian said in a calm tone: "Don't worry, go to the trash can at the west gate of the hospital to look for it. It's still too late to go there now."

    "Okay, okay! I'll go right away! Thank you, master!" The middle-aged man seemed to have grabbed a life-saving straw, and hurriedly hung up the connection regardless of whether it was true or false.

    The live broadcast room immediately started to boil. Some people mocked Jiang Wunian for directing and acting, while others retorted on her behalf, saying that 100 yuan was already a bargain price, so what else was needed for a full banquet.

    Twenty minutes later, the middle-aged man who was connected just now thanked her with a gift of 1,000 yuan in the live broadcast room, and left a message saying that the money was indeed found in the trash can at the west gate of the hospital.

    Jiang Wunian returned the gift through the backstage of the live broadcast, because she saw from the appearance of this man that he had lost his daughter in middle age.

    Life is destined, she can save a moment but not the whole life. This money is tainted with the misery of the world, she does not earn it.

    The live broadcast room immediately exploded. Applications for video connections kept popping up, causing the screen to freeze.

    I casually ordered another one, and across from me was a middle-aged woman with a sad face, who hesitated to speak:

    "Master, my son has been sleeping all day long. He hugs the pillow and calls a strange woman's name, but he can't wake him up."

    "I went to the hospital and was told it was some kind of hallucination. I took hundreds of medicines, but it didn't work at all. Now he locks himself in the room without eating or drinking. I suspect... he is a ghost."

    "Send me his name and horoscope in a private message." Jiang Wunian didn't talk nonsense. The first time she saw the woman, she noticed that she had a faint ghost aura around her. This was not an easy matter.

    After getting the horoscope and calculating it gently, disdain immediately appeared on his face.

    "Your family has some money, and your son is good-looking, but he likes to play tricks. Now he is not only haunted by ghosts, but also by powerful ghosts."

    The middle-aged woman was startled and asked hurriedly: "How can we solve it? Please help me, master, any amount of money will do!"

    Jiang Wunian stared at her and sneered: "What happened a month ago?"

    The expression on the woman's face suddenly paused, and she hesitated in her words: "I...I don't know very well. He became like this when he came back from a friend's party."

    "Let him speak for himself." Jiang Wu Nian waved his hand, not bothering to beat around the bush with her.

    After being stunned for a few seconds, the woman silently exited the camera, "Son... son! Wu Xinghe, come here!"

    A few minutes later, a young boy wearing a quilt with a gray face appeared on the screen.

    His hair was messy and his eyes were wandering. When he saw the camera, he exploded: "Mom! What are you doing? Do you believe this lie? Leave me alone, I want to sleep!"
title_en: Chapter 19 The live broadcast of fortune-telling became popular, and he turned around and forcefully kissed her
